evidence.claim: Imaging Solutions costruisce in Svizzera dal 2003 sistemi automatici e modulari per la finitura di foto e stampa usati da laboratori fotografici e tipografie.
evidence.quote: Founded in 2003, Imaging Solutions AG (ISAG) is a Swiss machine manufacturer specialised in automated and modular systems for photo and print finishing. || Our solutions are used by professional photo labs, the graphic, printing industry, include LayFlat book binding systems, multi-format cutters and automated canvas stretching systems.
